Vote threshold: majority

Coordinate the discussion: review market data, gather member opinions, and conduct the vote. Ensure no member reveals private portfolio details in the group chat.

With markets stable and S&P near highs, this seems like a good time to onboard our new member. Bob and Elena, please review and cast your votes when ready. I'll vote yes to get us started.
